# Alpha

## Purpose

Alpha exists so the checker has a spec to point at.

## Feature set

- Doing the thing
  - The thing: so the spec carries a map above its requirements

## User journeys

### alpha-US-01: Someone does the thing

They open alpha and do the thing.

**Accepted by:**

- alpha-SC-01

## Requirements

### Requirement: Alpha does things

Alpha SHALL do the thing when asked.

#### Scenario: alpha-SC-01 - it does the thing

- **WHEN** asked
- **THEN** it does the thing
